# Every language NAME the ingest language map can put in the artifact — the `name` of each
# LANGS entry in src/lib/ingest/languages.ts, sorted. This is the domain LanguageToChroma has
# to cover; a name here with no entry there is an uncoloured file nobody would notice.
#
# Regenerated and checked by TestIngestLanguageListIsCurrent, which re-derives it from
# languages.ts. When Phase 6 moves the language map into Go, that test points at the Go map
# and this file goes away.
